title: Uruguayan Beef Skewers
description: A classic Uruguayan dish featuring marinated beef skewers grilled to perfection. Serve with chimichurri sauce for an authentic touch.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, brown sugar, and ground cumin.
Add the chopped yellowed onion and minced garlic to the marinade mixture. Stir to combine.
Add the Uruguayan beef cubes to the marinade mixture. Toss to coat evenly.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread the marinated beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the beef is cooked to your liking.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with chimichurri sauce, if desired.
